root_idea.summary: The root centers on an opening, cleaving, or separation in a thing.
root_idea.development: From physical splitting or fissuring it extends to crossing or cutting through, separating groups, vegetation breaking the earth, and openly declaring truth as though cleaving concealment. Head-splitting pain is a metaphorical development.

senses.definition: To make the charged truth or message manifest and proclaim it openly.
senses.usage_conditions: In فَاصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ, the command is understood as openly announcing what was entrusted to the Prophet, without fear, and distinguishing truth from falsehood.

senses.definition: To cleave or divide a collective body, setting its members apart.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic command, this is understood as separating the congregation through the public declaration of the message; the construction may also be explained as dividing or distinguishing between truth and falsehood.

senses.definition: To cause head-splitting pain; to afflict with a headache.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic passive construction refers to being afflicted with headache or head-splitting pain, not to being made drunk or exhausted.

senses.definition: To become split, separated, or dispersed into distinct parts.
senses.usage_conditions: In يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصَّدَّعُونَ, the people become separated into opposing parties, one for Paradise and one for Hell.

senses.definition: A cleft, fissure, or crack, especially a cleaving in the earth.
senses.usage_conditions: In وَالْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ الصَّدْعِ, the expression is understood as the earth possessing a cleft or being split open.

senses.definition: Vegetation that breaks through the earth.
senses.usage_conditions: In the same Quranic expression, الصَّدْعُ is also explained as the plants that cleave the earth, or as the earth opened by plants and springs.

senses.definition: Splitting apart or breaking into fissures.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic active participle describes a thing becoming cleft or broken apart under an overwhelming force.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cleave, split, slit, or crack a hard thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of hard objects such as glass, walls, and similar materials; it may also describe slitting or rending a garment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To traverse or cut across a desert or river; of a road, to extend through a tract of land; to travel through the night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are figurative extensions of cleaving or cutting through space.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To separate, disperse, or scatter things, or to divide a herd into portions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be a thing, a group, or livestock divided into two flocks or herds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To direct one's course toward someone because of that person's generosity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the construction صَدَعَ فُلَانًا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hit or attain the proper place or object in an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized construction with بِالأَمْرِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To incline toward a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs with إِلَى and the thing toward which one inclines.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn someone or something away from another person or thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive construction with عَنْ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In an idiom, for the earth to conceal a fleeing person as though it had cleft around him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in تَصَدَّعَتِ الأَرْضُ بِفُلَانٍ; this is an idiomatic specialization distinct from ordinary separation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become cloven, split, slit, or cracked.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of hard things, walls, eggs, garments, and the earth; of dawn, it means to break.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cleft, split, slit, or crack in a hard thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of such things as glass vessels and walls; plural صُدُوعٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A separated part or portion of a thing, especially of sheep or goats.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An infinitive used substantivally for a portion separated from a larger whole.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single united company or alliance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the expression نَاسٌ عَلَيْهِمْ صَدْعٌ وَاحِد, the people are united against someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man of light flesh, or of middling stature.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence gives both a light-bodied and an intermediate-stature description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Either half of a thing cleft or split in two.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct nominal form from صَدْعٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A company or group of men.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate nominal usage from the sense of a half of a split thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who creates a division in a people's social state and does not repair it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic, figurative application.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of middling size or condition, between two extremes; youthful and strong.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a mountain-goat, gazelle, wild ass, camel, or other thing intermediate between large and small, young and old, fat and lean, or similar opposites.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Penetrating, sharp, or effective in an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival application to a person and his conduct or judgment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A half of a thing cleft, split, or slit in two.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal form distinct from صِدْعٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A separate herd or flock, especially of camels, sheep, goats, gazelles, or cattle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Some authorities specify a herd of about sixty animals, but the broader sense is a separate herd or flock.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small amount of property or money.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression عَلَيْهِ صِدْعَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ, especially of a small debt or amount owing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Divisions or disagreements in opinion and affection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of divisions existing among people and of the divisions that should be repaired by restoring unity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Headache, understood metaphorically as a splitting sensation in the head caused by pain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for the condition, distinct from the causative Form II verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A half of a garment or other piece split in two, or a garment that is slit or much rent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of a رِدَاء or similar cloth; the form may also designate the split or rent piece itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A new patch in an old garment, a black mourning garment, a garment worn beneath armor, or a middling-sized shirt.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are specialized apparel usages of the same headword and are not reduced to the general sense of a crack.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A youthful or middling-sized mountain-goat, or an animal between two sizes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal description related to the intermediate-size sense of صَدَعٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Daybreak, because it cleaves the night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fresh milk that has cooled and become covered by a thin skin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name is explained by the removal or cleaving off of the thin skin from the clear milk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Extending far along the earth, when applied to a valley, road, way, or mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative active-participial use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Shining or bright, when applied to daybreak.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Equivalent to a bright or emerging dawn; distinct in headword from the noun صَدِيعٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who decides or judges between people or parties.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active-participial application to a mediator or judge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The most effective or decisive among them in giving a right answer quickly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative or superlative expression concerning correctness and speed of judgment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A smooth or plain road through rugged ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A place-noun or descriptive noun for a clearly passable route.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A type of arrowhead or arrow called مِشْقَص.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Plural مَصَادِعُ; the same form also occurs in the expression for a quiver that stores such arrows.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A guide who proceeds energetically along his way.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agent noun with a figurative forceful or purposeful sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A perspicuous, eloquent, and bold orator or preacher.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agent noun describing clarity and courage in speech.
